VRSK_2011_p103__title_0.ocr: VERISK ANALYTICS, INC. NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS — (Continued)

VRSK_2011_p103__paragraph_0.ocr:
Company recorded acquisition related liabilities and goodwill of $3,500, which was paid in April 2011. AER was
acquired in 2008 and therefore, accounted for under the transition provisions of FAS No.141(R).

VRSK_2011_p103__paragraph_1.ocr:
During the second quarter of 2011, the Company reevaluated the probability of D2 and SA achieving the
specific predetermined EBITDA and revenue earnout targets for exceptional performance in fiscal year 2011 and
reversed its contingent consideration related to these acquisitions. These reversals resulted in a reduction of
$3,364 to contingent consideration and a decrease of $3,364 to “Acquisition related liabilities adjustment” in the
accompanying consolidated statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2011. The sellers of D2
and SA will not receive any acquisition contingent payments.

VRSK_2011_p103__paragraph_2.ocr:
During the third quarter of 2010, the Company reevaluated the probability of TierMed achieving the
specific predetermined EBITDA and revenue targets and reversed its contingent consideration related to this
acquisition. This revaluation resulted in a reduction of $544 to contingent consideration and an increase of $544
to “Acquisition related liabilities adjustment” in the accompanying consolidated statements of operations during
the year ended December 31, 2010. The sellers of TierMed will not receive any acquisition contingent payments.
